name: dsh-pi
description: 把 pi 编码代理接进 DSH：侧栏「pi」整页聊天面板，底层是常驻的 pi --mode rpc 子进程。pi runtime is resolved from the plugin itself (.runtime), so the panel works on any machine without a hand-written path.
